record.question: __________ is a line which is provided to check the accuracy of the fields.
record.explanation: A check line (proof line) provides an independent measurement to check the accuracy of a survey framework. The DGT surveying text uses this term for precisely that purpose. Reference: https://bharatskills.gov.in/pdf/E_Books/Surveyor1stsemTT.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
